evidence.title: GitHub - chiphuyen/machine-learning-systems-design: A booklet on machine learning systems design with exercises

name: Machine Learning Systems Design
summary: Booklet on machine learning systems design with 27 interview-style questions and practical links.
description: A short booklet covering the four main steps of designing a machine learning system: project setup, data pipeline, modeling (selecting, training, debugging) and serving (testing, deploying, maintaining). Includes links to practical resources, case studies written by ML engineers at major tech companies, and 27 open-ended machine learning systems design questions for interviews; community answers live in the repo.
contains: four parts: project setup, data pipeline, modeling, serving
community answers contributed in the repo
